title: OpenAI shut down Sora on April 26, 2026 — $15M/day compute cost, $2.1M lifetime revenue

The lesson: specific AI tools are volatile; the content format they serve is not.

title: The trifecta is complete: Netflix (Apr 30), Amazon Prime Video (May 8) and Disney+ all launch vertical video feeds — vertical is now standard premium-streaming infrastructure

This moves China from ad hoc enforcement to a formal compliance regime.
